verdict.rationale: llama.cpp explicitly documents custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA GPUs plus HIP support for AMD GPUs and MUSA for Moore Threads GPUs, alongside CPU+GPU hybrid inference for partial VRAM offload. Community reports corroborate real-world CUDA acceleration (with some noted speedup limits), confirming the vendor-specific GPU kernel approach works in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of AMD HIP or MUSA performance (only NVIDIA CUDA has community corroboration).
